admin.acqAutoApproveHint: Otherwise only requests.auto accounts skip approval.
admin.acqDeleteAfterImportHint: Removes the download from its client and deletes its files, which also stops seeding a torrent. The library copy stays.
admin.acqEnabledHint: Searches on its own for what is missing, then for better versions.
admin.acqEngineDesc: Restarts on its own when these settings change.
admin.acqFlaresolverrHint: For indexers behind Cloudflare. Leave empty to use none.
admin.acqGeneralDesc: Automatically search your indexers for approved requests.
admin.acqRecycleBinHint: Leave empty to delete a replaced file at once.
admin.acqReplaceOnUpgradeHint: Off keeps the old file beside the new one.
admin.acqRssMinutes: Read the indexers' latest releases every (minutes)
admin.acqStallHours: Give up on a download after (hours)

admin.acqVpnDesc: Kill switch, tunnel check and whether indexer searches route through the VPN.
